title: TASE job status
description: The state of a job (design §2.6). A counter that the supplier did not report is null, never 0: the difference between `null` and `0` is the difference between an unknown bill and a free operation.

state.description: The state the job is in.

attempt.description: How many times the job ran.

base_commit.description: The commit the job started from.

new_commit.description: The commit the job produced, when it produced one.

checks.description: The checks that ran on the job.

metrics.description: The counters of the job, when the job reports them.

cached_input_tokens.description: The tokens that were read from the cache of the supplier.

reasoning_tokens.description: The tokens of the reasoning, when the supplier reports them apart.

llm_cost_usd.description: What the model cost, in dollars.

worker_cost_usd.description: What the worker cost, in dollars.

elapsed_ms.description: How long the job took, in milliseconds.

identifier.description: An identifier of the contract: not empty, at most 128 characters, `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]` only.
